objections.claim: BA's AC7 (5.7 cross-ref linter) for triple-duplication says 'duplicate transit segment: <name> appears in N>1 places at overlapping times'
objections.problem: BA's literal threshold N>1 (which catches simple double-duplications) is STRICTER than spec 5.7 (which speaks of 'any duplicate route/segment that appears in BOTH transportation.intra_city_routes AND timeline.travel_segments AND timeline.timeline for the same day at overlapping times' — implying triple, not double). However, spec 5.7 acceptance also says 'Reproduce the G5415 / 五通桥 triple-duplication → linter blocks the write' — which is consistent with double also being blocked (since triple implies prior double exists). BA's tightening is reasonable; not a true drift but worth flagging.
objections.required_evidence: BA's AC text is acceptable. Spec wording allows interpretation flexibility. Recommend BA add a clarifying note in AC7 that 'duplicate appears in 2+ source files for same day at overlapping times' is the operational rule, matching the spec acceptance bullets.
